examples.en: There is a deep, soft armchair in my room.
Grandpa is sleeping in the armchair.
I like to photograph nature.
Taking photos is not allowed here.

note: Bookish; in speech «сликати» is more common.

examples.en: You need a copy of your passport.
Where can I make a photocopy?

forms: gen. фреске; gen. pl. фресака / фреска

examples.en: There are beautiful frescoes in the monastery.
They restored the old fresco.
I booked an appointment with the hairdresser.

All the players came out onto the field.

She put her glasses in the case.

examples.en: For dessert we had halva with walnuts.
Grandma makes homemade halva.

Frozen herring must be thawed.

You can hear an accordion from the tavern.

We bought paper for the printer.

There are two harps in the orchestra.
Let's grab a bite after work.
Yesterday we had ćevapi downtown.
Lift the hood so we can look at the engine.
Smoke is coming from under the hood.

Our handyman is coming tomorrow.

Grandma is teaching me to crochet.
These leggings are very comfortable.
She wears black leggings and a long T-shirt.

Hernia surgery takes about an hour.
Staple the sheets together with the stapler.
Lend me the stapler, please.

examples.en: Don't bash anyone if you don't know what happened.
I'm cooking buckwheat for lunch.
The store has two kinds of buckwheat.
I drink hibiscus tea.
Hibiscus blooms in summer.
Personal hygiene is very important.
Children learn about hygiene at school.

examples.sr: Она је веома [хѝровита] када је уморна.
examples.en: She is very moody when she is tired.

examples.en: Let's sit in the shade under the tree.
